body.name: Gaussian endpoint influence function
body.construction: For \(\vartheta\in\Theta\), \(\psi_S(O;\vartheta)=2(\mu_1-\mu_0)\{I_1e_1/\pi-I_0e_0/(1-\pi)\}+(1-t_S)I_0(e_0^2-v_0)/(1-\pi)+(1-t_S^{-1})I_1(e_1^2-v_1)/\pi+2\sqrt{t_S}\,w_S^{\mathsf T}I_0(x_Se_0-c_{0,S})/(1-\pi)-2w_S^{\mathsf T}I_1(x_Se_1-c_{1,S})/(\sqrt{t_S}\pi)-w_S^{\mathsf T}(x_Sx_S^{\mathsf T}-\Sigma_{SS})w_S\), where every component is evaluated at \(\vartheta\).
